chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding the censure of his companions
Amir al-mu'minin said: He censured his companions for their lack of retention and abundance of forgetfulness
ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ali criticize his companions' ability to remember his sermons?
ai.summary: In this admonition, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the specific failure of his companions to diligently record and preserve his sermons and sayings, a neglect that later contributed to the fragmentation of his teachings. This critique underscores the Shia emphasis on the active role of the companion in safeguarding the Imam's knowledge, contrasting their passive forgetfulness with the ideal of scholarly vigilance.
